results.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Will The Hurricanes Re-Sign Or Trade Alexander Nikishin?
results.description: It was reported following the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs that the Carolina Hurricanes were considering whether to trade or re-sign defenseman Alexander Nikishin. As training camp approaches, they don't seem any closer to doing either.
